The '''1966–67 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by three points over city rivals [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[St Mirren F.C.|St Mirren]] and [[Ayr United F.C.|Ayr United]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1967–68 Scottish Division Two|1967–68 Second Division]].
